messages:
Jules M: Heads-up - Everleaf Pharma asked for a compact enablement session to get their infra team comfortable with private deployments and metrics exports. They want a 90-minute hands-on session mid-May.
Tara P: Nice. Do they prefer mornings or afternoons?
Jules M: EMEA region but most attendees will be London-based; asking for mornings 09:00-10:30 BST ideally.
Diego R: I can do that slot. I can cover Private deployment install flow and monitoring dashboards.
Lenore V: I can cover onboarding checklist, RBAC, and audit log walkthroughs. I have a conflict on 2026-05-11 but free on 05-18.
Jules M: Let's propose 2026-05-18 09:00-10:30 BST. That gives us time to prepare a tiny lab that runs on their VPC test subnet.
Tara P: I can facilitate and collect attendee list. Also recommend we limit to 12 seats and request their CA/SC engineers attend.
Diego R: Plan for 75 minutes of content + 15 minutes for Q&A. Suggested agenda below.
cs_bot: Provisional calendar created: https://cal.example/event/2712345678. Poll: https://doodle.example/everleaf-enable-2712.

```
1) 09:00 - 09:10: Welcome, goals, and participant roll call (Tara)
2) 09:10 - 09:30: Private deploy overview & topology (Diego)
3) 09:30 - 09:50: Hands-on lab: bootstrap control plane in their test VPC (Diego)
4) 09:50 - 10:05: Security, RBAC, and KMS integration patterns (Lenore)
5) 10:05 - 10:20: Observability: dashboards, alerts, and exporting metrics (Diego)
6) 10:20 - 10:30: Next steps, success criteria, and quick feedback form (Tara)
```

Jules M: Two pre-work asks: (1) provide a test VPC subnet + IAM user for the demo, (2) share one example traffic profile (seq lengths + tokens) so we can precompute recommended batch/quant settings.
Lenore V: I'll draft the pre-work email and a short checklist for attendees.
Tara P: Can cs_bot attach a short feedback survey and a join link to the event? Also please mark as 'limited seats' in the description.
cs_bot: Added placeholder survey https://forms.example/everleaf-feedback and updated event description with seat limit.
Diego R: Can we run a 45min dry-run two days before to verify the lab VPC access and demos? I can do 2026-05-16 14:00 BST.
Jules M: Sounds good. Invite facilitators only to dry-run. Also capture the set of prompts we will use for the post-deploy sanity check (I'll add 6 quick prompts).
Lenore V: I'll reserve 'Enablement Lab 2' in London office for the time in case any Redwooder attends in person.
Tara P: After the session, we should send a quick renewal signal note to their AM summarizing readiness and any blockers. Let's add a one-line readiness rubric to the post-session notes.
Jules M: Excellent. I'll update the poll and message the Everleaf AM with the proposed date (2026-05-18), agenda, pre-work checklist, and poll link. Will update thread when they confirm. :rocket:
